about: Modwerk source-only MIDI Mute package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/midi-mute.

mods.title: MIDI Mute
mods.summary: Muted tracks also ignore MIDI notes coming in over USB and DIN, and a held note stops when its track is muted.
mods.description: Muted tracks, and tracks left out of a solo, drop incoming MIDI Note Ons from USB and DIN; a note MIDI holds is released when its track is silenced. Off by default: MUTE MIDI IN in GLOBAL > MIDI CONFIG > PORT CONFIG.
mods.author: michaelkollmann
mods.on_unit: This source (MM04) ran on the author's Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74 over USB and DIN, as reported in TESTING.md; this package has not run on a unit itself.
